The '''Unstoppable Horde''' was a vicious [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] gang operating during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3642 BBY]] they were present on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] and overran an outpost of [[Ortolan/Legends|Ortolan]] settlers. A survivor, [[Leebo Nobim]], retreated to a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] military base, where he tried to warn the soldiers of incoming menace, but was ignored. He then asked a Republic citizen to steal the combat stimulants that made the Gamorreans unstoppable in combat.
